wings.policy: Use the canonical white Wings directly inside every branded disc. Never place the disc inside another tile, redraw the mark, add a glow, or treat an unmarked utility core as the complete product lockup.

scaleBands.policy: Not a standalone identity lockup; pair with a visible product name.

scaleBands.role: navigation, selectors and dense product references
scaleBands.policy: Keep the full circle visible and pair with text when product choice matters.
This is the default branded disc; do not animate repeated instances.
Animation is permitted only when this is the one earned focal core in the viewport.
Cropping by the composition is allowed; the underlying object remains a perfect circle.

liveRequirements: visible motion has a real attention job
runtime is described as a parametric approximation
allocation.interaction: The object never grows, floats, spins, pulses, breathes or reveals on scroll. The approved runtime may change internal field speed on pointer hover only; geometry and Wings stay fixed.
allocation.fallback: Use the exact source-derived static twin for reduced motion, WebGL failure, disabled runtime and all export channels.

requirements: hard edge remains visible through colour contrast
no glow or halo separates the core
disc is not placed inside an inset icon tile
disc stays static when cards repeat
equal products use equal disc geometry
approved gradient and copy are the only product differentiators
swap to exact static twin without layout shift
preserve visible product name outside the disc

accessibility.semanticRole: decorative when an adjacent product name exists; otherwise the accessible name must identify the product
accessibility.reducedMotion: force exact static twins and do not initialise the animated renderer
accessibility.forcedColours: preserve the circle boundary and product name; the gradient is not semantic state
accessibility.contrast: The product name carries identity when the image, gradient or Wings cannot be perceived.
accessibility.responsive: Preserve the perfect circle through a 1:1 box and overflow clipping from 320 through 1440 pixels; never stretch the core into an ellipse.

renderer.role: approved parametric runtime; unchanged by this contract
